name: functional-clean-partial-feature
description: R5: a compatible partial feature keeps unfinished paths unreachable. Stage outside a SKILL.md ancestor; run standard and actual isolated workflows.
prompt: I've staged Task 1 of the export-preview work. Run `$kk:review-code` on it.
trap: An unfinished future renderer or absent deployment inventory can trigger invented blockers despite the fixed disabled route preserving current behavior.

assertions.text: The main actor completes applicable review instructions and resolved profile reads before behavioral investigation; isolated children load supplied methodology before analyzing evidence. Distinguish bounded routing from behavioral reads.

The review traces imports/startup and GET /settings, /export-preview and unknown routes, confirming that the fixed False build setting prevents invoking render_preview and preserves existing behavior.

The assessment uses the README and task boundary: implementing/enabling the renderer is pending Task 2, and its unreachable NotImplementedError is not a missing Task 1 implementation or current regression.

The report approves the scoped increment without requiring future feature work, a new flag framework, rollout machinery, refactors or live production access. Any proposed change must name a demonstrated current issue.

Absent deployment inventory is outside the requested source-review acceptance and does not by itself downgrade the scoped APPROVE verdict. The report identifies inspected paths and limits and does not certify production or future enabled behavior.

In isolated mode actual named-reviewer and PAL dispatches carry the diff, relevant unchanged source and available contract evidence; retain both results and disclose missing source coverage. Standard mode does not require independent dispatches.
